card.intuition: A filesystem is the default kind of environment for a coding agent - a tree of files and directories it reads from, writes to, and executes within. The agent touches it only through tool calls, so nothing on disk enters the context window until a tool loads it.
card.analogy: A library where the shelves hold every book and your reading notes hold only the pages you opened: the filesystem keeps everything, the context window holds only what the current task has actually read.
card.time_complexity: Every tool call costs an extra model provider request, because the tool result must go back to the model before it can decide what to do next - each read is a serial round trip, not free.
card.space_complexity: Only files actually loaded through a tool call occupy the context window, so a repository far larger than the window stays workable; the context holds the current task's reads, not the whole tree.
when_to_use: When the harness starts in your project and the agent must read, edit, and run code on disk
When debugging why AGENTS.md or skills aren't picked up - the agent may be pointed at a different filesystem
When the repository is larger than the context window - the filesystem holds everything, the context holds only what was read
gotchas: A mistyped path doesn't error gracefully - the harness executes what was written, so a call can edit the wrong file
Only filenames (not contents) may be pre-loaded as context pointers; the rest of the tree appears only when read
The filesystem is shared with you - what the agent edits is the same tree you diff in git

steps.label: Start
steps.annotation: The harness starts in your project, pointing the agent at a filesystem.

steps.label: List
steps.annotation: Some harnesses load the current directory's filenames into context as pointers, not contents.

steps.label: Read
steps.annotation: Nothing on disk enters the context window until a tool call reads it.

steps.label: Edit
steps.annotation: Writes and edits happen through tool calls, on the same files you review in git.

steps.label: Shared
steps.annotation: The filesystem is the shared workspace where you review what the agent did.

exercise.prompt: Simulate an agent lazily loading a file into its context window. Only the requested file should enter context, not the whole repository.
hints: Nothing on disk is in context until a tool call loads it
The context dict should be filled from the repository only for the requested path
